verdict.rationale: Asana's docs describe rule-based automation, webhooks, and AI Studio 'no-code automations' that can trigger workflows, which plausibly support recurring/automated processes, but no evidence explicitly confirms scheduling recurring jobs (e.g., cron-like triggers or time-based recurring workflow runs). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/scheduled triggers, independent confirmation of recurring workflow execution, and detail on how AI Studio or rules support time-based recurrence.
